summary: One-frame event raised by esv::CharacterManager when a character's move toward an entity (pick-up / drop) ends. Created by bg3.exe+0x33351A0 (AllocRaw 0x10) in the CharacterManager per-frame update bg3.exe+0x3320D90, which copies a 16-byte record (8-byte handle + 1-byte value) gathered by bg3.exe+0x3333610 from esv::character::EntityMovingComponent holders. Read by esv::pickup::PickUpExecutionFinishedSystem (ProcessSuccessfullyFinishedMoves) and esv::drop::DropEntityEndUpSystem (Toolkit). Never seen alive. Registry total 16 (server row).

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x33351A0 writes 0xffc0000000000000 (null EntityHandle) at +0; writer bg3.exe+0x3320D90 copies the record's first qword. Toolkit esv::pickup::PickUpExecutionFinishedSystem::ProcessSuccessfullyFinishedMoves (EoCServer.dll+0xD46D70) uses +0 as the key of a per-entity map (FUN_1809a3c30(&map, component)).

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: Creator writes byte 2 at +8; writer bg3.exe+0x3320D90 copies one byte: `*(undefined1 *)(puVar14 + 1) = *(undefined1 *)(puVar12 + 1)`. The Toolkit reader stores `*(undefined4 *)(component + 8)` next to the entity in its map (a result/state code; the Toolkit build reads 4 bytes, bg3.exe writes 1).

open_questions: Meaning of the byte at +8 (default 2; probably a move result enum). Whether it is wider than one byte (Toolkit reads 4 bytes).
Not seen alive (seen.py has no samples).
